title.en: How a group of pupils go to school

caption.en: In a picture graph, each picture stands for something counted. Here one picture is one pupil: 14 pupils in this group.
caption.zh: 在象形图里，每个图表示数过的东西。这里一个图是一个学生：这一组一共 14 人。

caption.en: With more to count, one picture can stand for 2 pupils. The key tells you so: 4 mango pictures mean 4 × 2 = 8 pupils.
caption.zh: 要数的多了，一个图可以表示 2 人。图例会告诉你。4 个芒果图表示 4 × 2 = 8 人。

caption.en: Half a picture is half of 2: 1 pupil. So rambutan is 4 × 2 + 1 = 9, not 5 and not 4.
caption.zh: 半个图是 2 的一半：1 人。所以红毛丹是 4 × 2 + 1 = 9 人，不是 5，也不是 4。

words.zh: 芒果 8 · 榴梿 6 · 红毛丹 9 · 香蕉 4

caption.en: Stack the pictures and draw round them: you get a bar graph. Now you do not count pictures; you read where each bar ends on the scale.
caption.zh: 把图叠起来，沿外边画一圈，就成了条形图。这时不用数图，看每根条顶到刻度的哪里。

keyFacts.en: Read the key first: how many does one picture stand for?
keyFacts.zh: 先看图例：一个图表示多少？

keyFacts.en: A bar graph shows the same numbers with bars and a scale.
keyFacts.zh: 条形图用条和刻度表示同样的数。

prompt.en: How many stickers does Mei Ling have?
prompt.zh: Mei Ling 有几张贴纸？

guide.en: Count Mei Ling's pictures, then use the key: each picture stands for 2 stickers.
guide.zh: 数一数 Mei Ling 的图，再看图例：每个图表示 2 张贴纸。

hints.en: Read the key first: how many does one picture stand for?
hints.zh: 先看图例：一个图表示多少？

hints.en: Mei Ling has 5 pictures.
hints.zh: Mei Ling 有 5 个图。

say.en: The key says one picture stands for 2 stickers. 5 pictures stand for 5 × 2 = 10.
say.zh: 图例说一个图表示 2 张。5 个图表示 5 × 2 = 10。

fallback.en: Not yet. Read the scale first: how much is one gridline? Then look again.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先看刻度：每一格表示多少？再看一遍。

prompt.en: How many cups were sold in all that morning?

hints.zh: 先看图例：一个图表示多少？

hints.en: There are 19 pictures in all.
hints.zh: 一共有 19 个图。

say.zh: 你数的是图的个数：19。每个图表示 5 杯：19 × 5 = 95。

fallback.en: Not yet. Read the scale first: how much is one gridline? Then look again.

prompt.en: How many stickers do the four friends have altogether?
prompt.zh: 四个朋友一共有几张贴纸？

guide.en: Add each friend's stickers: 8, 6, 10 and 4. Or count all the pictures and multiply by 2.
guide.zh: 把每人的贴纸加起来：8、6、10、4。也可以数全部的图，再乘 2。

hints.en: Read the key first: how many does one picture stand for?

hints.en: 14 pictures in all.

say.en: You counted the pictures: 14. Each one stands for 2 stickers: 14 × 2 = 28.
say.zh: 你数的是图的个数：14。每个图表示 2 张：14 × 2 = 28。

prompt.en: How many more stickers does Mei Ling have than Daniel?
prompt.zh: Mei Ling 比 Daniel 多几张贴纸？

guide.en: Find both numbers with the key, then take the smaller from the larger.
guide.zh: 用图例求出两个数，再用大的减小的。

hints.en: How many more? Look at the gap between the tops.
hints.zh: 多多少？看两个顶端之间差多少。

hints.en: Mei Ling has 10, Daniel 4.
hints.zh: Mei Ling 有 10 张，Daniel 有 4 张。

say.zh: 多多少，是两个顶端之间的差：10 − 4 = 6。

fallback.zh: 还没对。先看刻度：每一格表示多少？再看一遍。

prompt.en: Which class collected more books?
prompt.zh: 哪个班收集的书多？

guide.en: The two graphs have different keys. Find each number first, then compare the numbers.
guide.zh: 两张图的图例不一样。先求出各自的数，再比数。

hints.en: Read the key first: how many does one picture stand for?
hints.zh: 先看图例：一个图表示多少？

hints.en: Class A: 4 × 5. Class B: 6 × 2.

correct.en: Yes. Class A has 4 × 5 = 20 books, Class B 6 × 2 = 12.

say.en: Class B has more pictures, but each is only 2 books: 6 × 2 = 12. Class A has 4 × 5 = 20.
say.zh: B 班的图多，可每个图只表示 2 本：6 × 2 = 12。A 班是 4 × 5 = 20。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the chart again, one part at a time.
fallback.zh: 还没对。再看一遍图，一部分一部分地看。

reveal.en: Yes. Class A has 4 × 5 = 20 books, Class B 6 × 2 = 12.

caption.en: A bar graph has a title, a label on each axis and a scale. On this scale each gridline is 1 and every second one has a number.
caption.zh: 条形图有标题，两条轴各有名字，还有刻度。这个刻度每一格是 1，每隔一格写一个数。

caption.en: To read a bar, go from its top straight across to the scale. Mei Ling read 15 books: her bar ends on the line just above 14.
caption.zh: 读一根条，从顶端平平地看到刻度上。Mei Ling 读了 15 本：她的条顶在 14 上面那一格。

caption.en: How many more books did Mei Ling read than Ravi? It is the gap between the two tops: 15 − 7 = 8, not 15.
caption.zh: Mei Ling 比 Ravi 多读了几本？看两个顶端之间差多少：15 − 7 = 8，不是 15。

caption.en: A bar graph can also lie on its side. Read along to the scale at the bottom. Together the four friends read 43 books.
caption.zh: 条形图也可以横着放，往下看到底下的刻度。四个人一共读了 43 本。

keyFacts.en: From the top of the bar, go straight across to the scale.
keyFacts.zh: 从条的顶端平平地看到刻度。

keyFacts.en: "How many more" is the difference between two bars.

caption.en: Look where the axis starts. On the left it starts at 20, so the bar for 28 looks twice as tall as the bar for 24. From 0, they are nearly the same.
caption.zh: 看轴从哪里开始。左边从 20 开始，28 的条看起来是 24 的两倍高。从 0 开始画，两根条差不多高。

hints.zh: 先看图例：一个图表示多少？

say.en: The key says one picture stands for 10 pupils, so half a picture is 5. Here that makes 35.
say.zh: 图例说一个图表示 10 人，半个图就是 5。这里一共是 35。

fallback.en: Not yet. Read the scale first: how much is one gridline? Then look again.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先看刻度：每一格表示多少？再看一遍。

title.en: Cups sold at a drinks stall in one day
title.zh: 一个饮料摊一天卖出的杯数

prompt.en: How many more cups of lime juice than barley water were sold?
prompt.zh: 酸柑汁比薏米水多卖了几杯？

guide.en: Read both bars on the scale, then find the gap.
guide.zh: 按刻度读出两根条，再求差。

hints.en: How many more? Look at the gap between the tops.
hints.zh: 多多少？看两个顶端之间差多少。

say.en: How many more is the gap between the two tops: 45 − 20 = 25.
say.zh: 多多少，是两个顶端之间的差：45 − 20 = 25。

say.en: Each gridline here is 5, not 1. The top is at the 5th line: 5 × 5 = 25.
say.zh: 这里每一格是 5，不是 1。顶端在第 5 格：5 × 5 = 25。

fallback.en: Not yet. Read the scale first: how much is one gridline? Then look again.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先看刻度：每一格表示多少？再看一遍。

title.en: Cups sold at a drinks stall in one day
title.zh: 一个饮料摊一天卖出的杯数

prompt.en: How many cups of soya bean milk were sold?
prompt.zh: 豆奶卖了几杯？

guide.en: Tap a bar to draw a line from its top to the scale. Then read where the line meets the scale.
guide.zh: 点一根条，会画出一条从条顶到刻度的线。再读这条线碰到刻度的地方。

hints.en: Read the scale first: how much is one gridline?
hints.zh: 先看刻度：每一格表示多少？

correct.zh: 对。30 和 40 正中间是 35。

say.en: The top is halfway between 30 and 40. Halfway is 35.
say.zh: 顶端在 30 和 40 正中间。正中间是 35。

fallback.en: Not yet. Read the scale first: how much is one gridline? Then look again.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先看刻度：每一格表示多少？再看一遍。

reveal.zh: 对。30 和 40 正中间是 35。

prompt.en: Complete the table from the tally marks.
prompt.zh: 按划记把表格填完整。

guide.en: Count in fives, then add.
guide.zh: 五个五个地数，再加起来。

hints.en: Each bundle is 5.
hints.zh: 每一捆是 5。

say.en: Each bundle is 5: four strokes and one across. Count in fives: 5, 10, 15, then 16, 17. That is 17.
say.zh: 每一捆是 5：四竖加一斜。五个五个地数：5、10、15，再 16、17。一共是 17。

fallback.en: Not yet. Check each cell you wrote against the tally or the total.
fallback.zh: 还没对。把你填的每一格和划记或总数对一对。

prompt.en: The total is 80. How many pupils chose swimming?
prompt.zh: 总数是 80，选游泳的有几人？

guide.en: Take the rows you know away from the total.
guide.zh: 用总数减去知道的几行。

say.en: The total is all the rows together. Take the rows you know away from it: 80 − 25 − 18 − 14 = 23.
say.zh: 总数是所有行加起来。用它减去知道的几行：80 − 25 − 18 − 14 = 23。

fallback.en: Not yet. Read the scale first: how much is one gridline? Then look again.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先看刻度：每一格表示多少？再看一遍。

title.en: Money in Siti's savings box at the end of each month
title.zh: Siti 储蓄罐里每月底的钱

prompt.en: Between which two months did the savings increase the most?
prompt.zh: 哪两个月之间钱增加得最多？

guide.en: Look for the steepest part going up.
guide.zh: 找往上最陡的一段。

hints.en: Work out each rise.
hints.zh: 算出每一段升了多少。

correct.zh: 对。1 月到 2 月：多了 15 元。

say.en: June is the highest point, but from May to June the rise is only $10. January to February is $15.
say.zh: 6 月的点最高，可 5 月到 6 月只升了 10 元。1 月到 2 月是 15 元。

fallback.en: Not yet. Look at the chart again, one part at a time.
fallback.zh: 还没对。再看一遍图，一部分一部分地看。

reveal.zh: 对。1 月到 2 月：多了 15 元。

prompt.en: ¼ of the 40 pupils take the bus. How many is that?
prompt.zh: 40 人里 ¼ 坐巴士，是几人？

hints.en: The whole circle is 40.
hints.zh: 整个圆是 40。

say.en: ¼ is a part of the whole, not 4. ¼ of 40 = 40 ÷ 4 = 10.
say.zh: ¼ 是整体的一部分，不是 4 个。40 的 ¼ = 40 ÷ 4 = 10。

prompt.en: Read the temperature at 2 pm, in °C.
prompt.zh: 读出下午 2 点的气温（°C）。

guide.en: The point is halfway between two gridlines.
guide.zh: 点在两条格线正中间。

hints.en: Read the scale first: how much is one gridline?
hints.zh: 先看刻度：每一格表示多少？

correct.zh: 对。30 和 32 正中间是 31 °C。

say.en: The top is halfway between 30 and 32. Halfway is 31.
say.zh: 顶端在 30 和 32 正中间。正中间是 31。

fallback.en: Not yet. Read the scale first: how much is one gridline? Then look again.
fallback.zh: 还没对。先看刻度：每一格表示多少？再看一遍。

reveal.zh: 对。30 和 32 正中间是 31 °C。
